The '''Gorphs' grotto''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] where a tribe of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings known as [[Gorph/Legends|Gorphs]] lived. As of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], they were ruled by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Slugga]], who presided in her audience chamber within the grotto. A large number of hulking Gorph guards did her bidding there, as did her son, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Vork (Gorph)|Vork]]. Anyone Queen Slugga disapproved of was cast into a dark hole in her audience chamber known as "[[Pit (Gorph's grotto)|the pit]]."<ref name="Princess Latara">{{Ewoks|Princess Latara}}.</ref>
